_meta.note: /catalog, /landmarks, and /search require no key (RelayAccess.IsGroupPath excludes them by design) and carry no application request-rate limit. Catalog upstream fetches are constrained by the path/mode allowlist and cache; repeated relay work is not caller-limited. /report has a per-derived-room counter, but rotating invented keys bypasses a relay-wide bound on an open relay.

scenario.actor: anonymous, no X-Group-Key header sent or required
scenario.amplificationNote: /catalog/{mode}/{endpoint} fetches json.tarkov.dev on a cold or expired allowed path. The fixed mode/path allowlist, one-hour cache, and single fetch gate bound upstream amplification; they do not rate-limit repeated work at the relay HTTP surface.

contrastEndpoint.control: ProblemReports.IsRateLimited caps one derived room at 3 requests per hour, but is not a process-wide or per-IP limit
